name: world-of-wonder
description: A multiplayer 3d top down rpg whose currency and items live on a chain. Forked from orion3dgames/t5c.

scripts.test:startup: node scripts/build-server.mjs && node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/node.test.ts --out dist/test/node.mjs && node dist/test/node.mjs
scripts.test:economy: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/Economy.test.ts --out dist/test/economy.mjs && node dist/test/economy.mjs
scripts.test:market: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/Market.test.ts --out dist/test/market.mjs && node dist/test/market.mjs
scripts.test:inventory: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/Inventory.test.ts --out dist/test/inventory.mjs && node dist/test/inventory.mjs
scripts.test:outbox: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/Outbox.test.ts --out dist/test/outbox.mjs && node dist/test/outbox.mjs
scripts.test:api: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/Api.test.ts --out dist/test/api.mjs && node dist/test/api.mjs
scripts.test:addresses: node scripts/build-server.mjs --entry src/server/kei/api.test.ts --out dist/test/addresses.mjs && node dist/test/addresses.mjs
